title: Running Percentage of Total
scenario: Calculate the running total percentage of usage for each subscriber.
tableSchema: usage (sub_id INT, event_date DATE, bytes INT)
hint: Divide SUM(bytes) running total by SUM(bytes) over the entire window.
correctQuery: SELECT sub_id, event_date, SUM(bytes) OVER(PARTITION BY sub_id ORDER BY event_date)::NUMERIC / SUM(bytes) OVER(PARTITION BY sub_id) AS running_pct FROM usage;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE usage (sub_id INT, event_date DATE, bytes INT);
